headline: Premier League referees' body apologizes to Man United after derby offside controversy
description: Pro Ref, the Premier League referees' body, has apologised to Manchester United after admitting VAR awarded Erling Haaland's winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 win by "error."

headline: Micah Richards: Manchester derby a 'bad day for referees' after Phil Foden red, Erling Haaland winner
description: Micah Richards said the Manchester derby was a "bad day for referees" after City claimed a 1-0 win with a controversial goal.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Wrongly awarded goal costs Man United
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

headline: Lisandro Martínez, Michael Carrick blast 'injustice' to allow Erling Haaland, Man City's winner in derby
description: Lisandro Martínez branded the decision to allow Manchester City's winning goal against Manchester United as "an injustice" while Michael Carrick said it was an "obvious" error.

headline: Maresca fine with Foden red, says Bruno should have been sent off too
description: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca backed referee Michael Oliver's decision to send off Phil Foden in his team's 1-0 win against Manchester United, but said that Reds captain Bruno Fernandes should also have been shown a red card.
